appearance:
Appearance

Each part of the chart has its own settings. XAxis and YAxis set the scale, title, tick labels, baseline, and grid. Legend sets the display mode, position, alignment, and swatch shape. Tooltip sets the surface, the text colors, and the crosshair. Tooltip.ContentFunc names a global JS function that returns the tooltip HTML for the hovered row, and it replaces the default title and rows.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:  uiDisplay.ChartTypeArea,
	XAxis: uiDisplay.ChartXAxisSettings{
		RowKey:             "month",
		IsTickStartEndOnly: true,
		TickLabelColor:     "secondary-300",
	},
	Series: []uiDisplay.ChartSeriesSettings{
		{RowKey: "received", Label: "Received", IdentityColor: "secondary-500"},
	},

	// OptionalFields
	Cartesian: uiDisplay.ChartCartesianSettings{
		YAxis: uiDisplay.ChartYAxisSettings{
			Position:         uiDisplay.ChartYAxisPositionRight,
			IsGridLineHidden: true,
		},
		AreaFillStyle: uiDisplay.ChartAreaFillStyleSolid,
	},
	Legend: uiDisplay.ChartLegendSettings{
		DisplayMode: uiDisplay.ChartLegendDisplayModeAlways,
		Position:    uiDisplay.ChartLegendPositionBottom,
		Alignment:   uiDisplay.ChartLegendAlignmentEnd,
		SwatchShape: uiToolset.ShapeSquare,
	},
	Tooltip: uiDisplay.ChartTooltipSettings{
		BackgroundColor:   "secondary-950/95",
		ValueColor:        "secondary-200",
		RingColor:         "secondary-500/40",
		IsCrosshairHidden: true,
		ContentFunc:       "chartDemoTooltipContent",
	},
	Rows: chartDemoMonthlyTrafficRows(),
})

donut:
Donut

Donut reads one value per row from the first series. XAxis.RowKey names the slice, and the legend lists the slices in row order. Slices.SliceIdentityColors sets the color of a slice by its name. The first donut leaves the center label hidden; the second turns it on. Slices.CenterLabelDisplayMode shows the slice name and its value in the hole: Always keeps the CenterLabelAlwaysSlice value, or the first slice when it is empty, until a hover replaces it, and Hover shows the label only while a slice is hovered. CenterLabelSize scales both lines, and CenterLabelValueSuffix follows the value.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:  uiDisplay.ChartTypeDonut,
	XAxis: uiDisplay.ChartXAxisSettings{RowKey: "service"},
	Series: []uiDisplay.ChartSeriesSettings{
		{RowKey: "usedGib", Label: "Storage (GiB)"},
	},

	// OptionalFields
	Tooltip: uiDisplay.ChartTooltipSettings{ValueFormat: ",.1f"},
	Slices: uiDisplay.ChartSliceSettings{
		CenterLabelDisplayMode: uiDisplay.ChartCenterLabelDisplayModeAlways,
		CenterLabelAlwaysSlice: "mariadb",
		CenterLabelSize:        uiDisplay.ChartCenterLabelSizeLg,
		CenterLabelValueSuffix: " GiB",
		HolePercent:            70,
		SliceIdentityColors:    map[string]string{"mariadb": "sky-500"},
	},
	Rows: []map[string]any{
		{"service": "mariadb", "usedGib": 42.5},
		{"service": "nginx", "usedGib": 3.2},
		{"service": "php-webserver", "usedGib": 18.9},
		{"service": "redis", "usedGib": 6.4},
	},
})

gauge:
Gauge

The gauge type draws a needle over a track, with optional colored bands and a center label. It renders as plain SVG with the meter role, so the page needs no Vega head tag. Gauge.ArcThickness sizes the track and the bands, while NeedleThickness, NeedleLength, and PivotRadius shape the needle. NeedleColor paints the needle and its pivot, and ValueColor and LabelColor paint the center text.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:      uiDisplay.ChartTypeGauge,
	AriaLabel: "CPU load",

	// OptionalFields
		Gauge: uiDisplay.ChartGaugeSettings{
			Value:       65,
			NeedleColor: "secondary-400",
			Bands: []uiDisplay.ChartGaugeBandSettings{
				{MinimumPercent: 0, MaximumPercent: 60, Color: "emerald-500"},
				{MinimumPercent: 60, MaximumPercent: 80, Color: "amber-500"},
				{MinimumPercent: 80, MaximumPercent: 100, Color: "red-500"},
			},
			Label: "CPU",
		},
})

gauge-text-size-and-offset:
Gauge Text Size and Offset

Gauge.ValueTextSize and Gauge.LabelTextSize set the two center font sizes; the defaults are 24 and 12. Gauge.TextOffset moves the pair down, away from the pivot; the default is 0. The viewBox grows with the offset and the larger of the two text sizes, and widens for a long value or label, so the text never clips.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type: uiDisplay.ChartTypeGauge,
	AriaLabel: "Disk usage",

	// OptionalFields
	Gauge: uiDisplay.ChartGaugeSettings{
		Value:          72,
		IsSemicircle:   true,
		Label:          "Disk usage",
		LabelTextSize:  16,
		NeedleColor:    "sky-400",
		TextOffset:     20,
		ValueTextSize:  36,
	},
})

Live Example
gauge-ticks:
Gauge Ticks

Gauge.TickCount draws evenly spaced tick marks with a label per tick across MinValue and MaxValue. Gauge.TickPosition places them outside the track (the default) or inside it; TickColor and TickLabelColor paint them. ArcThickness widens the track and the bands together.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type: uiDisplay.ChartTypeGauge,
	AriaLabel: "Requests served",

	// OptionalFields
	Gauge: uiDisplay.ChartGaugeSettings{
		Value:           65,
		IsSemicircle:    true,
		Label:           "Requests",
		MaxValue:        100,
		NeedleColor:     "sky-400",
		ArcThickness:    20,
		NeedleThickness: 5,
		NeedleLength:    60,
		TickCount:       5,
		TickPosition:    uiDisplay.ChartGaugeTickPositionOutside,
		Bands: []uiDisplay.ChartGaugeBandSettings{
			{MinimumPercent: 0, MaximumPercent: 60, Color: "emerald-500"},
			{MinimumPercent: 60, MaximumPercent: 100, Color: "neutral-700"},
		},
		TickColor:      "neutral-50/50",
		TickLabelColor: "neutral-400",
	},
})

parliament:
Parliament

Parliament draws one dot per seat over concentric semicircle rows. XAxis.RowKey names the party and the first series holds the seat count. Parties fill the seats as contiguous blocks, ordered by row and then left to right. RowCount sets the number of rows, DotShape picks the dot symbol — circle, square, diamond, cross, triangleUp, or triangleDown — DotGapPercent sets the empty share of the space between seats, and DotSizePercent scales each dot on top of that space.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:  uiDisplay.ChartTypeParliament,
	XAxis: uiDisplay.ChartXAxisSettings{RowKey: "party"},
	Series: []uiDisplay.ChartSeriesSettings{
		{RowKey: "seats", Label: "Seats"},
	},

	// OptionalFields
	Parliament: uiDisplay.ChartParliamentSettings{RowCount: 6, DotGapPercent: 20},
	Tooltip:    uiDisplay.ChartTooltipSettings{ValueFormat: ",.0f"},
	Slices: uiDisplay.ChartSliceSettings{
		SliceIdentityColors: map[string]string{"Center": "sky-500"},
	},
	Rows: []map[string]any{
		{"party": "Center", "seats": 52},
		{"party": "Alliance", "seats": 41},
		{"party": "Greens", "seats": 27},
	},
})

Pie

Pie is a donut with no hole. It reads the same rows as the donut, ignores Slices.HolePercent, and hides the center label. Each slice shows its share of the total on a rounded pill, so the label stays readable on a small slice; Slices.SliceLabelPillBackgroundColor paints the pill, Slices.SliceLabelColor paints the text, and Slices.IsSliceLabelHidden removes both.

progress:
Progress

The progress type shows how much of a task is done. It draws no Vega canvas, so a page that uses only the progress type needs no Vega head tag. Size takes xs, sm (the default), or md and sets the track height and the label text size; MinWidthClass, MaxWidthClass, MinHeightClass, and MaxHeightClass replace the default w-full and the size height. The label sits on a rounded dark pill so it stays readable over any fill; LabelBackgroundColor and LabelTextColor repaint it. LabelPrefix and LabelSuffix wrap the percent text. IsStriped draws diagonal stripes in StripeColor over the fill.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type: uiDisplay.ChartTypeProgress,

	// OptionalFields
	Progress: uiDisplay.ChartProgressSettings{
		Value:                  65,
		ShouldShowPercentLabel: true,
	},
})

progress-thresholds:
Progress Thresholds

Without custom thresholds the bar follows the capacity defaults: cyan below 50, amber from 50, amber-600 from 75, red-600 from 85, and red-800 from 90. Thresholds replace the defaults; the first matching threshold wins, so list the highest first, and DefaultColor paints every percent below the lowest threshold. MinValue and MaxValue set the range the bar maps to a percentage, and Label replaces the percent text.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type: uiDisplay.ChartTypeProgress,

	// OptionalFields
	Progress: uiDisplay.ChartProgressSettings{
		Value:                  78,
		ShouldShowPercentLabel: true,

radial-bar:
Radial Bar

Radial Bar is a circular bar chart. It reads the same rows as the donut, and each category gets one bar that grows outward from Slices.HolePercent to the outer edge. Each bar shows its share of the largest value at its midpoint on a rounded pill; Slices.IsSliceLabelHidden removes that label, Slices.SliceLabelColor paints it, and Slices.SliceLabelPillBackgroundColor paints the pill. The legend lists the categories in row order. CenterLabelDisplayMode has no effect on a radial bar.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:  uiDisplay.ChartTypeRadialBar,
	XAxis: uiDisplay.ChartXAxisSettings{RowKey: "service"},
	Series: []uiDisplay.ChartSeriesSettings{
		{RowKey: "usedGib", Label: "Storage (GiB)"},
	},

	// OptionalFields
	Tooltip: uiDisplay.ChartTooltipSettings{ValueFormat: ",.1f"},
	Slices: uiDisplay.ChartSliceSettings{
		CenterLabelDisplayMode: uiDisplay.ChartCenterLabelDisplayModeAlways,
		HolePercent:            40,
		SliceIdentityColors:    map[string]string{"mariadb": "sky-500"},
	},
	Rows: []map[string]any{
		{"service": "mariadb", "usedGib": 42.5},
		{"service": "nginx", "usedGib": 3.2},

stacked:
Stacked

Cartesian.StackMode stacked piles the series on each other. Cartesian.StackMode percent shows each series as a share of the total, and the Y axis switches to percent. IdentityColor takes a color token for the series line, area, bar, marker, legend swatch, and tooltip swatch.

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:  uiDisplay.ChartTypeBar,
	XAxis: uiDisplay.ChartXAxisSettings{RowKey: "month", Title: "Month"},
	Series: []uiDisplay.ChartSeriesSettings{
		{RowKey: "received", Label: "Received", IdentityColor: "sky-500"},
		{RowKey: "transmitted", Label: "Transmitted", IdentityColor: "amber-500"},
	},

	// OptionalFields
	Cartesian: uiDisplay.ChartCartesianSettings{StackMode: uiDisplay.ChartStackModePercent},

sunburst:
Sunburst

Sunburst is a donut with a second ring. XAxis.RowKey names the category and Sunburst.ChildRowKey the child. The inner ring holds one arc per category, and the outer ring one arc per child. A category arc spans the sum of its children. A row with an empty child draws its category arc only. Children draw in their category color at 60 percent opacity. Each arc shows its percentage at its midpoint on a rounded pill: a category arc shows its share of the total and a child arc its share of its category. Slices.IsSliceLabelHidden removes those labels, Slices.SliceLabelColor paints them, and Slices.SliceLabelPillBackgroundColor paints the pill.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:  uiDisplay.ChartTypeSunburst,
	XAxis: uiDisplay.ChartXAxisSettings{RowKey: "team"},
	Series: []uiDisplay.ChartSeriesSettings{
		{RowKey: "usedGib", Label: "Storage (GiB)"},
	},
	Sunburst: uiDisplay.ChartSunburstSettings{ChildRowKey: "service"},

	// OptionalFields
	Tooltip: uiDisplay.ChartTooltipSettings{ValueFormat: ",.1f"},
	Slices: uiDisplay.ChartSliceSettings{
		SliceIdentityColors: map[string]string{"storage": "sky-500"},
	},
	Rows: []map[string]any{
		{"team": "storage", "service": "mariadb", "usedGib": 42.5},
		{"team": "storage", "service": "nginx", "usedGib": 3.2},
		{"team": "compute", "service": "php-webserver", "usedGib": 18.9},
		{"team": "compute", "service": "redis", "usedGib": 6.4},
		{"team": "backup", "service": "", "usedGib": 9.3},

})

waffle:
Waffle

Waffle shows the parts of a whole as a grid of equal cells. Each category gets as many cells as its share of the total. Waffle.CellCount sets the cell total (default 100), Waffle.ColumnCount the grid width (default 10), Waffle.CellShape draws squares or circles, and Waffle.CellGapPercent sets the space between cells (default 4). Colors come from Slices.SliceIdentityColors and the palette.
